BBBC021 High-Content Imaging Explorer

Note: PRISM viability measurements and BBBC021 microscopy images reflect distinct experimental protocols (120h viability across 500+ lines vs 24h MCF-7 imaging) and remain separated.

Step 7 — Pretrained AI Microscopy Analysis

Experimental Separation: BBBC021 high-content imaging (24h MCF-7 breast cancer cells) evaluates phenotypic/morphological disruption across 3 fluorescence channels (DNA, Tubulin, Actin), remaining completely separate from PRISM viability screens (120h pooled assay).

Step 8 — Interactive Cell-State Mapping

Global Projection Methodology: All 240 experimental fields across 7 compounds and vehicle controls are projected simultaneously into a single unified UMAP coordinate system using a fixed random seed (random_state=42), eliminating coordinate shearing and avoiding misleading comparisons between independently fitted projections.

Step 9 — Scientific Validation & Uncertainty Quantification

Validation Objective: Empirically evaluate out-of-sample prediction accuracy on held-out PRISM dose measurements without data leakage, quantify parameter uncertainty through bootstrap resampling, audit transition stability across resamples, and independently validate microscopy morphological inflection consistency.
